The Countries Where Rats Are on the Menu - BBC Future

_: In the Indian state of Bihar, the Dalit people are known as "rat eaters" and tend to the crops of wealthy landowners in exchange of the right to eat any rats they catch in the fields.
Rat meat dishes are popular in many restaurants, such as those in the city of Guangzhou's Panyu district.
Although rat is rarely eaten in most states, rat stew is a traditional dish in West Virginia.
The African giant rat is regarded as a special delicacy and its meat is more expensive than beef or fish.
In Mexican states such as San Luis Potosí and Zacatecas, one of the most popular dishes is "Caldo de rata de campo" (Rat Soup).
Field mice and rats are a popular delicacy and are often hunted in corn fields.
